operation.body:
### Goal

Create the Rails application scaffold for Feedback Inbox (SQLite, server-rendered HTML, no authentication) and record real setup, run, and test commands so subsequent goals can implement FR-001–FR-008 on a working codebase.

### Acceptance criteria

- Generate a Rails application in the repository root (or documented layout) using SQLite, omitting features out of scope (no API-only mode, no Docker requirement for v1).
- Record exact Ruby and Rails versions chosen, plus `bundle install`, database setup, server, and test commands in `README.md` and update the **Project readiness** table (`Real project commands recorded` → Yes with evidence).
- Resolve deferred decision rows in `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` that the scaffold can close (configuration, logging/errors at a baseline, tests/lint commands, retention/migrations commands once `db/` exists).
- Add a minimal smoke test (e.g. Rails default test suite green) and document how to run it in the PR validation section.
- Extend CI only if needed so adapter checks still pass and any new application test job is economical and documented; do not weaken existing adapter contract steps.
- Run `bash tests/test-adapter.sh` and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report outcomes in the PR validation section.
- Do not implement inbox product behaviour beyond an empty or placeholder home route (no FR-001–FR-008 flows yet). Do not edit `docs/security-review.md` or goal #3 scope.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met. Keep the change reviewable in one PR; use branch name containing `issue-<n>`.

### Out of scope

Full feedback CRUD, categorization, filtering, persistence acceptance tests for product behaviour, security checklist work, authentication, production deployment, and unrelated documentation churn.

### Relevant context

Readiness goal #5 merged (PR #7). Architecture direction and `ruby-rails` stack profile are active. See `.ai/docs/architecture-direction.md` and `.ai/stack-profiles/ruby-rails.md`.
